Jensen Huang just pulled off one of the fastest founder comebacks in corporate history. > Steve Jobs took 12 years to return to Apple. > Larry Page took 10 years to return to Google. > Howard Schultz took 8 years to return to Starbucks. > Jack Dorsey took 7 years to return to Twitter. > Michael Dell took 3 years to return to Dell. > Jensen Huang took 11 days to return to Nvidia. Nov 12, he resigned as CEO. Nov 17, the board said it "does not intend to reinstate" him. Nov 23, the same board voted unanimously to bring him back. $NVDA is up +26% premarket, adding roughly $1T. US stock market adds $3T in market cap following Huang's reinstatement. Founders aren't easily replaced. News | Markets | YouTube
